title: Name the member when a replayed completion receipt fails to decode
outcome: A stored completion result that this build cannot decode is refused on replay with a shape-only reason naming the offending member, as every other replayed result is, instead of the untagged union's generic "data did not match any variant of untagged enum WorkCompleteResult".
acceptance: Replaying a stored work_complete protocol result decodes it by its discriminant: a present seal selects WorkCompletedReceipt, and a refusal code selects WorkCompleteRefusal. The chosen variant's decode error, naming an unknown or missing member, reaches the caller, never the generic untagged-union mismatch.

The replayed-completion case in the replayed-pins test (a stored obligation page whose requirement names required_environment, with a value and as null) asserts the refusal names `required_environment`, like the update, note and gate cases.

completion.summary: A replayed completion result is now decoded by the shape it claims: a seal selects the receipt, otherwise a code selects the refusal. A result that does not decode is refused naming the member at fault, or only the kind of problem, never a stored value, instead of the untagged union's generic mismatch. The replayed-pins completion case names required_environment, like the other replays. Landed as 28ad8ff.
